name: Resource-based policy fails closed (not evaluated with identity rules)
note: IAM-501: every statement names a Principal -> detected as a resource-based policy. The engine models identity semantics only, so it STOPS before rule evaluation and returns a blocking coverage state. Critically, the identity WILDCARD-ACTION/WILDCARD-RESOURCE findings that would fire on this shape are NOT produced - firing them would overstate risk (a bucket policy grants access TO the named principal, it is not an identity holding s3:* on *).
